name: Query Console
summary: Client self-service analysis console: a pivot-style Builder and a validated query editor over the report's datasets, with a formatted results table, an automatic chart, CSV export, history and 'Add as metric'.
summary_zh: 客户自助分析控制台：透视表式“构建器”与带实时校验的查询编辑器，结果以格式化表格 + 自动图表呈现，支持 CSV 导出、查询历史和“保存为指标”。
description_zh: 让客户在报告内自己做分析：选择数据集，在 Builder 中按“值（聚合 × 字段）/ 分组 / 筛选 / 排序 / 前 N”拼出查询，或在 Query 中直接写 RK.query 语句（如 median(ev_ebitda_25e) by sector where region != "Latin America" sort 2 desc），编辑器带语法高亮、自动补全、防抖实时校验（错误信息 + 行列位置 + 波浪下划线）和 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 运行。右侧参考面板列出字段（标题、名称、格式）、@参数与函数，点击即插入光标处。结果以按字段格式显示的可排序表格 + 自动图表（一个类别列用柱状图，年份 / 日期用折线图，单位不同则双轴，单行汇总显示为大数字）分屏呈现；结果遵循全局筛选并在筛选变化时自动重跑。行级公式可“Add as metric”写回数据集（Dataset.addComputed），其他图表随即可用。
best_for: Letting clients answer their own follow-up questions on the comps / precedents / financials
Ad-hoc medians, averages and rankings by sector or region
Defining a new metric (e.g. EV / EBITDA 2026E) that other charts then use
Appendix 'data room' page of an interactive report
avoid_when: The page must tell one fixed story (use a purpose-built chart)
Printed deliverables (only the results table and chart print)
Very large datasets (> ~50k rows, the engine runs in the browser)

datasets.desc: Dataset ids offered in the picker (null = every loaded dataset)

dataset.desc: Initial dataset (default: the block's dataset, else the first available)

query.desc: Initial query text — opens the Query tab and runs on mount

builder.desc: Initial builder state {values:[{agg, field}], rows:[fields], where, sort:{col:'v0'|'r:field', dir}, top}; null = sensible default (median of a multiple by a low-cardinality text field)

examples.desc: [{label, query}] or query strings shown as clickable chips in the Query tab

tab.desc: Initial tab: builder | query (a 'query' option without 'builder' opens the Query tab)

chart.desc: auto | bar | line | none — auto = bar for one category column, line when it looks like a year / date

reference.desc: Side reference panel (fields, parameters, functions, syntax); collapses to a toggle in narrow blocks

history.desc: Remember recent queries in localStorage (silently disabled where storage is unavailable)

addMetric.desc: Offer 'Add as metric' for row-level formula columns (Dataset.addComputed)

highlight.desc: Value(s) whose result rows / bars are highlighted with accent-2 (e.g. the target company)

maxRows.desc: Rows rendered in the table (CSV exports all rows)

tools.desc: Block toolbar (off: the console has its own CSV export)

interactions: Builder: pick aggregation / field / group-by / filter / sort / top N — runs as you edit
Query editor: syntax highlighting, autocomplete (Tab / Enter), live validation with line / column and wavy underline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
Reference panel: click a field, @parameter or function to insert at the caret
Sortable result columns; chart follows the table order
Results respect global filters and re-run when filters or @parameters change
Add as metric (Dataset.addComputed) — the new field appears in every field list
CSV export, query history, example chips, dataset picker

examples.label: Median multiples by region
examples.query: median(ev_ebitda_25e) as "EV/EBITDA 25E", median(ev_ebitda_26e) as "EV/EBITDA 26E" by region from peers sort 2 desc

examples.label: Top 8 by EV/EBITDA 2026E
examples.query: company, ev / ebitda_26e as "EV/EBITDA 2026E" format "0.0x", rev_growth_25e as "Growth 25E" from peers sort 2 desc top 8

examples.label: Cash-generative peers
examples.query: company, net_debt_ebitda, dividend_yield from peers where net_debt_ebitda < 1.5 sort 3 desc

options.query:
company, ev / ebitda_26e as "EV/EBITDA 2026E" format "0.0x", ebitda_margin_25e as "EBITDA margin"
from peers where region != "Latin America"
sort 2 desc

examples.label: Sector medians
examples.query: median(ev_ebitda_25e), median(pe_25e), count() by sector from peers

examples.label: Size buckets
examples.query: if(mkt_cap > 8000, "Large cap", "Mid cap") as "Bucket", company, mkt_cap from peers sort 3 desc

examples.label: Industrial Automation peers
examples.query: company, ev_ebitda_25e, ebitda_margin_25e, tsr_1y from peers where sector == "Industrial Automation" sort 2 desc

options.query: year, revenue, ebitda, ebitda_margin as "EBITDA margin" from financials

examples.label: Revenue CAGR 2019A–25A
examples.query: cagr(last(revenue), first(revenue), 6) as "Revenue CAGR" format "0.0%", avg(ebitda_margin) as "Avg. margin" from financials where period == "A"

examples.label: FCF conversion
examples.query: year, fcf / ebitda as "FCF / EBITDA" format "0%", capex / revenue as "Capex % sales" format "0.0%" from financials

examples.label: Actuals vs plan
examples.query: avg(revenue_growth) as "Avg. growth", avg(ebitda_margin) as "Avg. margin" by period from financials
